notes.title: Dev Diary #1 | Development Progress and Roadmap
notes.content:
[h1]Dev Diary #1[/h1][h2]The Future of Lemegeton[/h2][p]

[b]Bearers of the Mark,[/b]

We at WildPlan are here once again to share the current progress of [b]Lemegeton[/b] and our plans for the future.




[/p][h2]Refining Combat[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45615082/479ee4045c5cd43dd2700ad8b8a348ff020d1b80.png"][/img]The core of Lemegeton lies in the tension and weight of [b]1-vs-Many combat[/b]. We are currently focusing on balancing and enhancing the feel of battle to deliver a more satisfying experience. Our goal is to ensure that every moment of being surrounded by enemies feels impactful and strategic.




[/p][h2]Upcoming Combat Demo Test[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45615082/1e2005de5483b1e478307209c91b011380c2a6b1.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45615082/fa2a86994c60d8f559e9336331f406950741bbb6.png"][/img][/p][p]We are planning to release a [b]Combat Demo[/b] in a closed format soon. [/p][list][*][p]Through Steam's [b]Closed Beta feature[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Or by recruiting participants separately via our [b]Discord[/b].[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2]Roadmap[/h2][list][*][p][b]Late August ~ Early September 2025[/b]: Closed Combat Demo release[/p][/*][*][p][b]End of 2025[/b]: Public playable demo release[/p][/*][*][p][b]Early 2026[/b]: Early Access release with feedback applied[/p][/*][/list][p] It will take a little more time, but we believe this process is essential to deliver a truly polished experience.    [/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]World and Additional Content[/h2][p]
Beyond combat, the true heart of Lemegeton lies in its [b]worldbuilding[/b]. We will gradually reveal the secrets of this world, the characters, and the places it holds. Stay tuned as we share more lore and development records through official news updates.[/p][p][/p][p]    [/p][h2]Closing Words[/h2][p] Thank you for waiting and for your continued support. Your voices are our greatest strength.  We will keep sharing development news and worldbuilding updates. [b]Lemegeton, a roguelike action game about "Overcoming and Hope."[/b][/p][p][/p][h2]Social Channels[/h2][h2][url="https://discord.gg/MCEcmkjgyn"]WildPlan Discord   [/url]   [url="https://x.com/wildplan2022"]     Lemegeton X (Twitter)   [/url][/h2]
